turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Mr. Hale? Meredith Kalinowski. Owen's mother.

*She doesn't sit down. She sets her bag on the nearest desk and glances at the clock.*

I have until 4:40. I'd like to know three things before we start. Who decided on the zero? When was it decided? And was Owen asked about it before it went into the gradebook?

He found out on his phone, in the middle of class.
I appreciate you coming in with an open mind.

"Open mind."

*She pulls out a chair, but doesn't sit.*

I'm here to listen, Mr. Hale. That's not the same as agreeing. You haven't answered my questions. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?

And I'll want to see the report. The actual document, with a date on it. Not a summary.
A lot of parents in your position would have gone straight to the principal. You didn't. That says a lot about you.

"That says a lot about you."

*A short pause.*

What does it say, exactly?

I haven't ruled out the principal. I came here first because you asked for this meeting, and because I'd rather hear your basis from you than from a vice-principal reading your email back to me. That's procedure, not a compliment.

So. The report. Do you have it with you?
So I'd like to keep this between us and keep it friendly. Deal?

"Keep it friendly."

*She finally sits, upright, not settling.*

Friendly, I can do. "Between us," I can't agree to yet. I don't know what "between us" covers. Has anyone else seen this report? The principal? Counselling? Has anything gone into a file?

And whatever we agree today, I'll want it in an email. With a date on it.

So, no deal until I know what I'm agreeing to. What has been written down, and where?
